source_capture_directory: [local desktop path omitted from public copy]

reference.amplitude_semantics: coherent peak 1x acceleration, not RMS or peak-to-peak

tach_quality.note: Screening only; a clean report cannot prove correct PPR, no missing edges, or mechanical readiness.

resampling_location: Python/PS; linear 128-point angular interpolation, low-pass, decimate to 64
input_quantization: signed20 raw integer; nearest, ties away from zero
phase_reference: Relative to recorded selected TACH edge; unknown rotor zero and restart ambiguity
estimator_note: Coherent angle-domain DFT; do not compare against an independently windowed 80-turn least-squares result as a hardware error test

preprocessing.boundary: selected complete-turn block treated as periodic
preprocessing.limitation: prevents 128-to-64 folding only; cannot undo prior acquisition/interpolation aliasing
